releaseNotes: Main app, payment sidecar, and documentation are aligned to version 1.4.1.
User-route proxy startup, billing hydration, and canvas persistence regressions are fixed in this patch release.
Runtime-truth docs, package governance, and verification gates are aligned to version 1.4.1.
Integration tests and payment-server static checks now participate in the standard verification chain.
Hosted release guidance and runtime guards are tightened to reduce dangerous fallback behavior.
